input: What has Salesforce changed in Agentforce pricing in 2026?

output.question: What has Salesforce changed in Agentforce pricing in 2026?
output.answer: Most recently, on November 4, 2026, Salesforce announced a new standalone Agentforce Coworker option at $50 per user per month, available immediately. On September 3, it introduced Core, Advanced and Max editions at $195, $395 and $550 per user per month respectively; Max kept Agentforce 1’s price, while the new bundles added AI, Slack, analytics, security and support. Those editions include 500,000, 1 million and 2.75 million Flex Credits respectively. Earlier, Salesforce announced Help Agent on June 25, with pay-per-resolution pricing available in July; its current listed price is $2 per resolution, with no charge for human escalation or negative feedback. These changes add purchasing options rather than replace the existing consumption models: as of November 10, Flex Credits remain $500 per 100,000 credits and conversation pricing remains $2, both already documented in May 2025.

key_facts.fact: On November 4, 2026, Salesforce announced a new $50-per-user-per-month Agentforce Coworker option and identified the per-user SKU as available immediately.

The September 3, 2026 announcement priced Core at $195, Advanced at $395 and Max at $550 per user per month. Max retained Agentforce 1 pricing; the editions bundle Agentforce, Slack, analytics, security and Premier Success support.
The September 3, 2026 announcement allocated 500,000 Flex Credits to Core, 1 million to Advanced and 2.75 million to Max.

Salesforce announced Help Agent on June 25, 2026, with pay-per-resolution pricing available in July 2026. Its announcement specifies no charge for negative feedback or human escalation and unmetered Agentforce and Data 360 during the interaction.
As of November 10, 2026, Salesforce's pricing comparison lists Help Agent Resolutions at $2, Flex Credits at $500 per 100,000 credits and Conversations at $2 per conversation.
The $500-per-100,000 Flex Credit price and $2-per-conversation model were already documented on May 15, 2025, so their introduction was not a calendar-2026 change.

passages.quote: A new $50 per-user, per-month option makes Coworker easier to budget as adoption grows.
Max Editions include 2.75 million Flex Credits
If a customer gives negative feedback or asks for human escalation, there is no charge
Flex Credits, available in packs of 100,000 credits ($500)

caveats: These are the principal verified pricing and packaging changes, not an exhaustive inventory of every Agentforce feature-specific billing change.

The September announcement explicitly says existing customer pricing on legacy editions remains unchanged; the new edition prices should not be interpreted as an automatic increase for every existing customer.
The September announcement scheduled Industry Edition pricing changes for later in the fall rather than establishing one universal effective date.
Salesforce states that pricing and packaging are subject to change and availability is governed by region and customer agreements.
The live pricing page does not display a publication date; its prices are reported as observed on November 10, 2026.
